status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment: The issue is pretty simple. GridMapQueryExecutor adds itself as message listener, but 1 does not protect itself with busy lock and 2 does not get removed on node stop. Please fix both issues here and similar issues in query. You can reassign this ticket with explanations.
